name: @plurnk/plurnk-bench
description: Benchmarking harnesses for the plurnk agent service — drive real benchmark task sets through @plurnk/plurnk, store/score/report the runs.

scripts.test:driver: python -m unittest discover -s deepswe -p 'test_*.py' && python -m unittest discover -s enterprise -p 'test_*.py' && python -m unittest discover -s terminal_bench -p 'test_*.py' && python -m unittest discover -s swebench -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test: npm run test:lint && npm run test:driver && npm run test:unit
